name: Ascension
audio: a thunderous brass swell, a roaring dragon, crackling flame and a rising drum; no speech
world: The citadel is alive: braziers flare, embers and sparks stream upward, heat haze ripples, banners snap in the updraft and the sunset sky burns orange and red.

actions.beat: The braziers along the battlement flare and the sky erupts in fire as Pyraxis dives into view behind the towers.
{{She}} thrusts the sword overhead and a pillar of white-gold fire spirals up the blade into the sky, {{her}} cape of flame snapping out behind {{her}}.
A ring of flame blooms outward across the battlement, embers streaming upward, as Pyraxis sweeps overhead and {{she}} turns a fierce, triumphant look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
